rows.en: ＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿００３How are you feeling, Cousin?￥You really scared me...
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿００４You're the type who overdoes it￥even on a good day, Cousin.＝＠１３７＿００５You've gotta look after your￥health, okay?
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿００６Is there anything you want?￥Something you'd like to eat?
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿００７You don't have to hold back with￥me, okay?
Thanks, Kaname.
You're family. I won't.
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿００８G-geez...￥If you thank me so formally,￥I'll get embarrassed!
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿００９I just wanted to be￥useful to you, Cousin,￥that's all...
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿０１０That's right!＝＠１３７＿０１１When we were little, we even￥took baths together.
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿０１２We're basically brother and￥sister. So... at least with me,￥don't put on a brave face, okay?
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿０１４You know, Cousin... the human￥body is more fragile than you'd￥think.
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿０１５You don't really notice it￥when you're healthy, but...
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿０１６So today, forget about training￥and rest up, even just a little.
Yeah, that's the plan.
I can't afford to rest.
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿０１７You always work way too hard,￥Cousin, so taking a little break￥won't hurt!
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿０１８What are you saying?￥You just collapsed!
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿０１９I didn't think you could be￥so childish, Cousin!
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿０２０Nobody wants to trust the future￥of humanity to someone who can't￥take care of themselves, right?
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿０２１Cousin, right now your job is to￥get better as fast as you can!
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿０２２Besides, once you're well, you￥can catch up on anything you￥missed, easy!
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿０２３Well, I'll get going... Get some￥good rest, okay, Cousin?
